description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what did $COMPANY say about X in their SEC filings" or "find filings that mention Y". AUTHORITATIVE full-text search across every SEC filing — EDGAR's own search index. Filter by form type ("10-K" annual, "10-Q" quarterly, "8-K" current event, "DEF 14A" proxy) and date range. Returns entity name, CIK, form type, filing/period dates, location, accession number (feed straight into edgar_filing_text / edgar_filing_documents — no second lookup), and — for 8-K results — the `items` array of item codes (e.g. "3.01" listing deficiency vs "1.01" material agreement vs "3.02" unregistered sale), which carry the actual signal. Use when you need to find filings matching a topic across the whole market, not for a specific company (for that use edgar_company_filings).

form_type.description: Filter by SEC form type (e.g., "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "DEF 14A"). Omit for all types.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-40, default 10)

name: edgar_search_filings

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format or null

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format or null
